get.summary: Locate Checked-In Bin by QR Code
get.description: Scans a bin QR HashCode and returns bin details if it currently contains unpicked stock.

get.summary: Locate a pallet by its pallet number
get.description: Finds a pallet by pallet number within a warehouse and returns its current bin location, if checked in.

get.summary: Locate a pallet by its QR code hash
get.description: Finds a pallet by its QR code hash within a warehouse and returns its current bin location, if checked in.

post.summary: Transfer a whole pallet to a new bin
post.description: Moves a checked-in pallet (and all its contents) from its current bin to a destination bin, logging the transfer.

post.summary: Transfer a single item to a new bin
post.description: Moves a single received product out of its current check-in and into a new check-in at the destination bin, logging the transfer.

get.description: Returns transfer log entries within a date range, optionally scoped to a single warehouse.

get.summary: List individually checked-in items in a bin
get.description: Returns item-level (non-pallet) received products currently checked in to the given bin.
